records.finding: Definitions 3.1/4.2 require an identified query and compatible observational/interventional priors. records.finding: Section 2.2 orders the competing event before the target event in an interval. Equations (1)-(3) therefore use the competing-event survival factor at the current time and prior survival for both events. The manuscript conversion lambda2=h2 and lambda1=(1-h2)h1 matches this convention and distinguishes marginal incidence from cause-specific survivor hazards.
